data.one_liner: In‑memory key‑value store with optional time‑to‑live expiration for entries.
data.what_it_does: Provides a simple Dart map‑like API where each entry can automatically expire after a configurable duration. Entries without a TTL remain until manually removed.
use_when: You need fast, temporary caching of data in memory
You want automatic expiration of cached values without external storage
avoid_when: Persistent storage across app restarts is required
You need disk‑based caching or large binary data handling
strengths: Supports per‑entry TTL and a clear method
weaknesses: Data is lost when the app is terminated
No built‑in persistence or disk caching

alternatives.name: flutter_cache_manager
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides disk‑based caching with expiration and works across app restarts
